final: WITH district_counts AS (SELECT d.district_id, d.A3 as region, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) as client_count FROM client c JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id GROUP BY d.district_id, d.A3), global_total AS (SELECT CAST(SUM(client_count) AS FLOAT) as total FROM district_counts) SELECT dc.region, AVG(CAST(dc.client_count AS FLOAT)) as avg_clients_per_district, AVG(CAST(dc.client_count AS FLOAT) / gt.total) as avg_share FROM district_counts dc CROSS JOIN global_total gt GROUP BY dc.region ORDER BY dc.region
